description: This PHP source file provides functions for handling XML processing within the TestLink project, including secure XML loading, XML data exporting, and parsing simple XML objects into PHP arrays. It also includes security measures against XXE attacks.

methods.name: simplexml_load_file_wrapper
methods.description: Loads an XML file securely by disabling external entity loading to prevent XXE attacks and provides error handling.

methods.name: exportDataToXML
methods.description: Exports an array of items to an XML string, with options for custom templates and headers.

methods.name: getItemsFromSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Converts a SimpleXML object into an array according to specified element and attribute structure, applying optional type casting and processing.
